# Fabien Chung — solodeveloping.com

> Fabien Chung is a Montréal-based Next-Gen Full-Stack Developer with
> 20+ years of experience. He specializes in Flutter mobile apps,
> React 19 / Node.js web platforms, and advanced AI automation
> ("Maîtrise avancée des IA"). Co-founder of 3 startups. Works solo,
> direct with clients, no agency middlemen.

## Identity

- Name: Fabien Chung
- Alternate names: Fab Chung, KooliFab
- Role: Next-Gen Full-Stack Developer
- Location: Montréal, Quebec, Canada
- Availability: Freelance, remote worldwide, also serves UAE
- Website: https://solodeveloping.com
- Languages: English, French

## Expertise

- Mobile: Flutter (7+ years, 15+ shipped apps), iOS, Android, React Native
- Web: React 19, Node.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router
- AI: LLM integration, AI agents, prompt engineering, Claude API, OpenAI API, generative AI, workflow automation
- Backend & infra: Firebase, cloud (AWS/GCP), PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- Other: Blockchain, product ownership, 3 startup co-founder experience

## Positioning

- English tagline: "Next-Gen Full-Stack Developer · Advanced AI Mastery"
- French tagline: "Développeur Full-Stack Nouvelle Génération · Maîtrise avancée des IA"
- Philosophy: One person, total accountability. Ship in days, not months. No overpromise, no underdeliver.
